name: The Westin Reserva Conchal, an All-Inclusive Golf Resort & Spa

transfer_minutes.label: Approximately 1 to 1.5 hours by private transfer from Guanacaste Airport (LIR) in Liberia.

hero_image_alt: The Westin Reserva Conchal, An All-Inclusive Golf Resort & Spa
description: A sprawling all-inclusive resort set near Playa Conchal on Costa Rica's Guanacaste coast, combining a golf course, spa, tennis courts, and family-friendly facilities. Guests enjoy multiple dining venues, outdoor pools, and supervised kids' activities in a relaxed beachside setting.
hero_description: All-inclusive golf and spa living on Guanacaste's stunning Playa Conchal coast.
local_insight: Ideal for travelers who want a hassle-free, all-inclusive base near one of Guanacaste's most beautiful beaches, with golf, tennis, and plenty for kids to do. Best suited to families and couples who prefer resort comforts over independent exploration.

faq.q: Where is The Westin Reserva Conchal located?
faq.a: The resort is located at Playa Conchal, about 1km before Playa Brasilito in the Guanacaste province of Costa Rica.

faq.q: Is the resort good for families with children?
faq.a: Yes, the resort features supervised kids' activities, a children's play area, a game room, and family suites with sofabeds, making it well-suited for families.

faq.q: What activities and amenities are available on-site?
faq.a: The resort offers a golf course, a full-service spa, outdoor pools, tennis courts, a fitness center, multiple restaurants, and lounge/bar options.

amenities: Supervised kids' activities and children's play area

traveler_profile_reasons.reason: The resort's on-site golf course makes it a natural fit for travelers who want to combine beach time with rounds on the green.
Supervised kids' activities, a children's play area, family suites with sofabeds, and a game room cater directly to families.
With multiple dining venues, pools, spa, and tennis all bundled in, it suits guests who prefer a stress-free all-inclusive stay.
